fixedText: This Master Services Agreement between Harbor Analytics LLC and Juniper Freight Co. took effect on March 1, 2026. Harbor Analytics provides route-optimization analytics, a hosted reporting dashboard and quarterly planning workshops. The dashboard must be available at least 99.5% of each month, excluding announced maintenance. The agreement runs for three years. After that, it renews automatically for one-year periods unless either party gives 90 days' notice. Juniper Freight pays a monthly service fee of $12,500. Invoices are payable within 30 days, and late amounts accrue interest at 1% per month. Either party may terminate for cause if the other party materially breaches and does not cure the breach within 30 days after written notice. Each party's liability is capped at the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim. The agreement is governed by Delaware law.

keyFacts.label: Parties
keyFacts.value: Harbor Analytics LLC, Juniper Freight Co.
keyFacts.quote: by and between Harbor Analytics LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Provider"), and Juniper Freight Co., an Oregon corporation ("Customer")

keyFacts.label: Effective date
keyFacts.quote: entered into as of March 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date")

keyFacts.label: Monthly service fee
keyFacts.quote: 3.1 Fees. Customer shall pay Provider a monthly service fee of $12,500.

keyFacts.label: Initial term duration
keyFacts.quote: 2.1 Initial Term. The initial term of this Agreement is three (3) years from the Effective Date.

keyFacts.label: Dashboard availability percentage
keyFacts.quote: 1.2 Service Levels. Provider will keep the dashboard available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced 48 hours in advance.

keyFacts.label: Invoice payment deadline
keyFacts.quote: 3.2 Invoices. Provider will invoice Customer monthly in arrears. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.

keyFacts.label: Late payment interest rate
keyFacts.quote: 3.3 Late Payment. Undisputed amounts not paid when due accrue interest at 1% per month.

keyFacts.label: Maximum annual fee increase
keyFacts.quote: 3.4 Price Changes. Provider may increase the monthly service fee once per year, by no more than 4%, with sixty (60) days' written notice.

keyFacts.label: Non-renewal notice period
keyFacts.quote: 2.2 Renewal. After the initial term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive one (1) year periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.

keyFacts.label: Data return deadline
keyFacts.quote: 6.2 Effect of Termination. On termination, Customer will pay all fees due through the termination date, and Provider will return or delete Customer data within forty-five (45) days.

intern.reply:
- "runs for five years" → "runs for three years" (source §2.1: three years).
- "monthly service fee of $18,500" → "$12,500" (source §3.1).
- "terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice" → "terminate for cause if the other party materially breaches and does not cure the breach within 30 days after written notice" (source §6.1; no termination-for-convenience clause exists).
